'''Kaliyo's apartment''' was an apartment owned by the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] anarchist [[Kaliyo Djannis]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="TOR:10" />

In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.1}}</ref> after Kaliyo and the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] destroyed [[Power Junction 353|Power Junctions 353]], [[Power Junction 754|754]], and [[Power Junction K-H82|K-H82]] in the [[Old World|Undercity]] of Zakuul, the two went to the apartment and planned to [[Raid on the Overwatch|raid]] the [[Overwatch]] command center.<ref name="TOR:10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaliyo's apartment appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during '''Chapter X: Anarchy in Paradise''' which was released on [[February 11]], [[2016]] as part of the Game Update 4.1.<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20160211|text=Play Now: ''Star Wars'': The Old Republic - Knights of the Fallen Empire, Anarchy in Paradise}}</ref>
